Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — AtlasOps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of needs
- Primary use: low-latency chat for customer support workflows (short responses, 64-128 token output)
- Expected peak qps: ~15-20 concurrent users initially, ramp to 100 within 6 months
- Security: must operate in a VPC with customer-managed KMS; SOC 2 readiness required
- Key success metric: avg 95th percentile latency < 200ms and cost target <$0.002 per 1k tokens

Proposed next steps
1) Internal trial: we can set up a 2-week pilot on Dedicated capacity (pin a single model variant) — I can provision trial capacity and share metrics. (Action: Marissa to provision by Fri)
2) Security Qs: Connor can share a light SOC2 evidence packet and typical network diagram. (Action: Connor)
3) Procurement: If pilot looks good, we can run a short mutual action plan to get to PO. Can you share any internal timelines/approval checkpoints?

Attachments: I attached a short discovery deck and our standard SOW template for reference.

If the above looks right, would love to book a 30-min pilot kickoff next week. I'm available Tue/Wed 10-2 PT.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole

Wanted to check in on where this sits on your roadmap. A few things we've seen help other customers move faster:

- A 1-week smoke test that proves latency targets without full dataset access
- A short mutual action plan with 3 checkpoints (pilot kickoff, procurement sign, pilot review)
